## Activity

During March 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 40 captures as part of its site activity. The activity covered the scheduled photography sessions for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with the available records showing 40 captures completed at the centre.

The monthly activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. Each capture was considered for image quality before the grading outcome was recorded.

## Image quality

Of the 40 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.0. The ungradable captures could not be used for grading, and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome.

## Grading

There were 10 referable results among the graded captures. The median lag from capture to grading was 17 days. This measure indicates the midpoint of the time taken for captures to progress through the grading process during March 2022. Overall, the report records the activity completed at Hill Counties Health Centre, the number of captures affected by image quality, and the resulting grading position for the month.
